name: Pulse-derived operating cell formation
outcome: A recurring pulse pattern becomes a reusable parameterized operating cell with named offices, duties, skills, staffing demand, endeavor/campaign parameters, cadence, engineering capability dependencies, independent receiving, and explicit decommission criteria.
consumes: leader-or-board-authorized demand or an already-admitted service obligation
repeated pulse evidence showing the work recurs or requires coordination
existing professional repertoire and Academy formation services

roles.corporate-secretary: preserve enterprise identity, authority chain, principal, and provenance
roles.configuration-manager: own parameterization revision and configuration baselines
roles.character-resources: form staffing demand, qualification, succession, and vacancy records
roles.task-dispatcher: release only work whose required capabilities are admitted and available
roles.pilot-department: run first bounded operational delivery without converting a prototype into production authority
roles.quality-operations: independently assay delivered effect against receiver acceptance

forbiddenDefaults: inventing a new product requirement without authorized Group/Board demand
treating a scheduled prompt as office authority
treating the same persistent actor changing office focus as an independent handoff
closing on source merge without operating receiver acceptance

operatingLaw: Operations defines the repeatable work form and consumes Engineering capabilities; it does not own bespoke capability implementations.
Repeated missing software capability becomes a provider-neutral capability demand to Red Cup Engineering with executable acceptance criteria.
A single persistent character may execute across offices it actually holds; handoff exists only when an independent endpoint, principal, or system receives.
Every operating cell exposes parameterizable endeavors; campaigns are repeatable bounded sequences inside an endeavor, not scheduler identities.
Staffing is an explicit demand with qualification and capacity evidence, not a model-session count.
The first delivery is a pilot; production status requires independent receiving and a durable capacity/cadence plan.
Cells with no continuing demand, payer, consumer, or institutional obligation are decommissioned rather than accumulated.

pulseExamples: wsmOASEf Land Relations and Title Intelligence
sourceEvidence.note: These are current Work Arena obligations observed by ChatGPT-Web; they motivate a reusable formation service rather than seven bespoke operating implementations.
